literal: According to the systematic path, the measure having known, one should learn, for the sake of giving a reply without fearing the assembly.
translation: One should study systematically, knowing the measure of what is to be learned, for the purpose of giving a fearless reply in an assembly.
modern: அவைக்கு அஞ்சாமல் பதில் கூறுவதற்காக, முறையான வழியில் நூல்களின் எல்லையை அறிந்து கற்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights how systematic learning builds the confidence needed for public speaking. To speak without fear in an assembly, one must learn by understanding the proper method and scope of the subjects. Knowing the limits and depth of knowledge prevents hesitation and errors when answering others. Thus, structured learning is presented as the foundation of fearless communication.
